eval: (()=>{let n=0; while(__game.dialogue.open && n<80){document.querySelector('.dlg').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true})); n++;} const g=__game; g.debug.quiet(); g.debug.crew('Mining',3); g.debug.crew('Carrying',2); g.timeScale=3; window.__ws={}; const t0=g.time; window.__wt0=t0; window.__wsI=setInterval(()=>{for(const w of g.workers){const k=w.profile.role[0]+':'+w.label; const s=window.__ws[k]??={stuck:0, frozen:0, skips:0, lostT:0, last:null, gaveUp:0, states:{}}; if(w.stuckT>0.4) s.stuck+=0.25*g.timeScale; if(s.last && Math.hypot(w.pos.x-s.last[0], w.pos.z-s.last[1])<0.05 && (w.state==='work'||w.state==='deliver'||w.state==='seek') && !(w.sinceHit<1.5)) s.frozen+=0.25*g.timeScale; s.last=[w.pos.x,w.pos.z]; s.skips=[...w.skip.values()].filter(v=>v>w.clock).length; s.states[w.state]=(s.states[w.state]??0)+1;}},250); return g.workers.length})()

(()=>{const g=__game, S=g.debug.state(); clearInterval(window.__wsI); const out={}; for(const [k,s] of Object.entries(window.__ws)) out[k]={stuckSec:Math.round(s.stuck), standingStillSec:Math.round(s.frozen), blocksGivenUp:s.skips, states:s.states}; return JSON.stringify({gameSec:Math.round(g.time-window.__wt0), progress:+g.progress().toFixed(2), mined:S.run.mined, hauled:S.run.hauled, workers:out})})()
